Delhi High Court dismisses plea against Vizag airport closure

The Delhi High Court has dismissed a petition challenging the closure of the Visakhapatnam airport. The court stated that the grievance should be addressed before the Andhra Pradesh High Court. The specific reasons for the closure or the petitioner's identity were not detailed in the coverage.
